hitl_conditions: Not explicitly discussed. Humans appear only upstream (fuzzy acceptable limits for cost, waste and quality encode decision-makers' preferences) and as managers who may pick among Pareto policies; inside the loop the system selects and implements policies itself.
key_finding: Embedding a fuzzy multi-objective model in an adaptive digital twin whose agentic layer re-weights objectives from the twin state cut logistics cost ~4-5% and waste ~13% and raised service level ~4% versus static weights, with faster post-disruption recovery; the loop selects and implements policies with no human step.

quotes.text: Although the current implementation is carried out within a simulation-based evaluation environment, its architecture is explicitly designed to synchronize with real-time data. The digital twin continuously updates the system state vector St

The network under study consists of several interconnected layers that start with raw material suppliers and end with processing centers, cold storage, transportation fleets, distribution centers, and retail outlets.

For each decision epoch t: / Extract system state St from the digital twin [...] Normalize weights / Solve fuzzy multi-objective model with updated weights / Select and implement the preferred Pareto solution

the agentic AI mechanism in this study is designed based on decision-making rules and priority resetting, and the use of more advanced learning approaches can enrich the agent’s behavior in the long run.
